items.q: we picked up AAKE PERSSON Okie Pearson, a Swedish trombone player.

ctx.x: Tell us something about it. I remember that band. Jerome Richardson, --
Well, the trumpets -- the trombones, rather, was Melba Liston, Jimmy Cleveland, and we picked up AAKE PERSSON Okie Pearson, a Swedish trombone player.
